# Dimas Prasetyo Tegar Asmoro

> Chief Technology Officer, VP Engineering, and Head of IT & Product. Technology executive with two decades in software engineering, currently CTO of PadiUMKM (PT Telkom Indonesia). Author and lecturer based in Jakarta, Indonesia.

Dimas Prasetyo Tegar Asmoro is a technology executive with two decades in software
engineering and more than a decade leading technology and product functions at
C-level. He progressed from Head of Engineering to VP Engineering to CTO at
PadiUMKM, PT Telkom Indonesia's national B2B marketplace for the MSME ecosystem,
in three years. His track record spans state-owned enterprise, pharmaceutical and
healthtech (Kalbe Group), agritech, and venture-backed marketplaces.

## Key facts

- Current role: Chief Technology Officer, PadiUMKM — PT Telkom Indonesia (Tribe SMB), Dec 2022–present
- Education: M.Kom. (Magister Ilmu Komputer), Universitas Bunda Mulia, cum laude, Best Graduate 2012; S.Kom. (Sarjana Komputer), STMIK Swadharma, cum laude, Best Graduate 2007
- Lecturer (Lektor) since 2007 — ITB Swadharma (2007–2020), STMIK Jayakarta (2021–present)
- Author of two books:
  - "Integrasi Node.js dan Kotlin untuk Aplikasi Point of Sales Sederhana" (ISBN 978-634-307-173-0)
  - "Machine Learning & Artificial Intelligence: Memahami Bagaimana Mesin Belajar dan Memanfaatkan Pembelajaran Mesin serta AI dalam Pekerjaan Sehari-hari" (ISBN 978-634-307-209-6 print, 978-634-307-210-2 PDF)
- ORCID: 0009-0005-0427-5735
